# Offline Mode Is Coming to Notes: Keep Working, Even Without a Connection

Your notes should be there when you need them, whether or not you have a signal. Offline Mode lets mobile users of the Notes app read, create and edit notes without a connection [F1]. When you reconnect, your changes sync automatically [F2].

## Why we built it

Losing work to a dropped connection is frustrating. The people who feel it most are field technicians and travelers, who lose work when connectivity drops [F3]. Our users have told us the same thing in their reviews: 23% of one-star app reviews in the last year mention losing a note offline [F4].

We took that feedback seriously, and Offline Mode is our answer.

## How it works

Offline Mode keeps your notes close to you. Notes are stored locally in an encrypted on-device database [F5]. When you make edits without a connection, those edits are queued and merged on reconnect [F6].

We also thought carefully about what happens when the same note is edited in two places. If the same note was edited on two devices, both versions are kept and you pick one [F7]. Nothing is silently overwritten [F7].

## What we saw in the beta

Before launch, we tested Offline Mode with 2,400 beta users over 8 weeks [F8]. Here is what we found:

- Sync conflicts occurred in 0.6% of synced notes [F9].
- There were zero data-loss reports during the beta [F10].
- Weekly active usage among beta users rose 12% compared with a control group [F11].

Conflicts are rare, and when they do happen, the choice stays with you [F7][F9].

## Availability

Offline Mode ships in app version 5.0 [F12] on iOS and Android [F13]. It launches on June 10 [F14] and is available for all plans [F15].

Offline storage is capped at 2 GB per device [F16].

## What Offline Mode doesn't do (yet)

We want to be clear about the scope of this release. Real-time offline collaboration is a non-goal [F17], and so is offline search across attachments [F18]. This first release focuses on the essentials: reading, creating and editing your notes without a connection [F1].

## Get ready for June 10

Update to version 5.0 when it arrives [F12], and your notes will be ready to go wherever you are. Whether you're on a job site or on the road, you can keep working, and your changes will sync when you're back online [F2].
